text:
anya: Quick idea — Mug Shrine Tournament this week. Bring your weirdest mug, post a pic, one-line origin story. Winner names the corner plant 🌿

matt: Ooh. I have the mug with the tiny lighthouse handle that smells faintly of burnt marshmallows. Challenge accepted.

priya: I'll bring the dinosaur-handle porcelain mug that only works if you hum 3 notes. True story. :t_rex: :joy:

jon: Does the plant accept bribes? Asking for a friend. :thinking_face:

anya: Rules: 1) photo in thread 2) one-line backstory 3) no stealing someone else's spoon 4) poll Friday 3pm. Winner gets naming rights and bragging emoji.

matt: uploading: https://imgur.com/placeholder-mug (tastefully cursed)

priya: <@matt> that mug is a mood. also 10/10 backstory potential. :raised_hands:

sam: Can we do instant runoff? My mug is two personalities: 9am optimistic, 3pm existential. :coffee: :sweat_smile:

anya: Ha. We'll accept personality shifts. Bonus points for dramatic backstory.

bot-decor: Heads-up: Please don't leave mugs on the router shelf — it triggers an 'angry wifi' incident. Automated office advisory. :robot_face: :wifi: (this is a friendly reminder)

jon: Noted. Also, if anyone finds a tiny stainless spoon with glitter, that's mine. Reward: one cookie or one sad desk plant pun.

priya: Cookie bribe accepted. Also vote with emoji — :trophy: for favorite, :heart: for runner-up.

anya: Poll opens Friday 3pm. Post pics here between now and then. May the best mug win. :cup_with_straw:
